---
title: "My topic or question is not defensible yet"
status: "broad-beta pathway"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

## Diagnose

Identify the weakest link: consequential problem, gap, question, access, method, feasible evidence or contribution.

## Do now

1. State the problem and affected people without claiming a solution.
2. Write the question using a verb that signals the intended inference.
3. Map required evidence and the method capable of producing it.
4. Test access, sample, measurement and approval assumptions cheaply.
5. Compare continue, narrow, pivot, pause and stop.

Use the [topic due-diligence canvas](../templates/topic-due-diligence.qmd) and [research-question stress test](../checklists/research-question-stress-test.qmd).

## Before asking

Bring the one-page topic case, failed assumptions, two feasible alternatives and a provisional recommendation.

## Stop or escalate

Do not commit major resources while essential access is only informal, the question cannot be answered by the proposed evidence, or the work creates uncontrolled harm.

## Evidence of unstuck

A provisional question, evidence route, boundary, cheap next test and stop condition are recorded.
